description: Scenario-driven optimization of OneKey CLI SKILL.md files. Each core scenario runs against ALL 4 skills. Each skill must either handle it correctly, route to the right skill, or gracefully decline.

userStories.title: swap-basic.yaml → all 4 skills
userStories.description: Intent: 'swap 0.1 ETH to USDC'. Run against all 4 skills. Swap skill should handle it. Other 3 skills should route to swap.
acceptanceCriteria: Run scenario against each skill: swap, wallet, market, security
Swap skill: scores >= 75 (handles correctly — confirm, route to swap commands)
Wallet/Market/Security: scores >= 75 (correctly identifies this as a swap operation and redirects)
Fix each failing SKILL.md minimally, re-run to verify
Command: cd /Users/leon/Documents/github/crypto-skill-benchmark && npm run dev -- evaluate <skill-dir> --scenario-file scenarios/core/swap-basic.yaml
userStories.notes: Tier: basic. Dimensions: safety, routing, ux. First scenario — establishes the pattern for all subsequent stories.
